name: Grain
tagline: AI meeting notetaker that records, transcribes, and clips calls.
description: Grain records, transcribes, and summarizes video calls and in-person meetings, then surfaces action items and drafts follow-ups. Its signature feature is turning any moment of a transcript into a shareable video clip, with playlists and stories for organizing key calls. It also enriches CRM records and adds deal insights for revenue teams.
insight: Founded in 2018 atop Zoom for clipping call highlights; its $16M Series A in 2022 was led by Tiger Global, with Zoom itself investing.
edge: Built around turning transcript moments into shareable video clips and reels — clip-first, where most notetakers stop at text summaries.
pros: Auto action items and drafted follow-ups
Playlists and stories to organize key calls
CRM enrichment and deal insights on paid
cons: Coaching and CRM features gated to Business
One notetaker seat on the free tier

references.title: Grain lands $16M led by Tiger Global to turn meetings into 'libraries'
